purpose: One spectral prediction function, with exactly three real cold inputs in fitting and inference.
study_status: Developmental extension after earlier inspection of NO/CH4. Fixed historical test identities stay completely excluded from parameter fitting; no newly blinded external validation is claimed.
broad_training: Existing ET parameters and species/source weights; only retained genuine three-input records. No fabricated, duplicated, or interpolated extra temperatures.
line_training: Three actual PNNL input spectra paired with native calculated hot reference spectra. Fit hot reference profiles to obtain supervisory area/width values. No tabulated mass, lower-state energy, quantum numbers, or line-list strength/width is an ML feature or target label.
gaussian_width: A single coefficient in sigma_G = d * wavenumber * sqrt(T) is fitted from the shapes of training hot spectra, with equal species weight. Each leave-one-species-out fold uses fitting species only. No molecular-mass lookup.
cold_routing: Per-feature intersection of existing <=0.40 cm-1 half-prominence width, >=1.30 cm-1 nearest peak, >=0.50 prominence/height, >=0.005 relative prominence, <=0.08 cm-1 sampling, in all three inputs. Same cold-fit quality thresholds as before. No global 90% window gate; mixed bands are permitted.
reconstruction: B + sum(L - G_2cm * L), clipped at zero. B is the 512-point ET envelope interpolated to the requested grid. L are eligible intrinsic fitted cold-observed line predictions; Gaussian convolution of each Voigt is analytic. This replaces fine contrast without adding its smoothed area twice. One fixed expression for full-band and point queries.
pressure: Only fitted Lorentz widths use pressure; broad envelope is not pressure-conditioned. Same target T/P and context window in band figures and concentration extraction.
selection: No architecture, thresholds, hyperparameters, or training subset chosen from NO/CH4 or ether hot errors. Evaluate line residual versus physical baseline using training-species-only LOSO; use residual only if species-balanced LOSO improves.
evaluation: Freeze code, both fitted heads and training protocol before recomputing all fixed held-out bands, then all concentration histories. Report envelope-resolution errors and native-grid errors separately. Use each same function in figures and retrieval.
display_projection: Band scoring requests output_fwhm_cm1=2.0 and uses the learned envelope directly, without a second Gaussian convolution. Sensing uses the unchanged default output_fwhm_cm1=0.
resolution_revision: For r<=2, max(B + sum(G_r L - G_2 L), 0); for r>2, convolve B only by sqrt(r^2-2^2). Unresolved background retains the envelope resolution for r<2.
